context.name: context
context.description: The context the dataset belongs to.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: The dataset's name in its context.

Wow-Request-Id.name: Wow-Request-Id
Wow-Request-Id.description: The caller's id of the request, kept as the command's request id: a retry with the same one is deduplicated.

Wow-Wait.name: Wow-Wait
Wow-Wait.description: The wait plan (decision D99): hops separated by `>`, each `accepted`, `committed`, `snapshot` or `handled(subscription)`, with an optional `(context)`, such as `handled(order/payment-saga) > committed(inventory)`. Without it the command waits for its snapshot.

Wow-Wait-Timeout.name: Wow-Wait-Timeout
Wow-Wait-Timeout.description: How long to wait: `500ms`, `10s`, `1m` or an ISO-8601 duration (`PT10S`).

Wow-Scope.name: Wow-Scope
Wow-Scope.description: The scope to act in, for a caller allowed to act across scopes: an RFC 8941 dictionary (decision D95).

Wow-Space.name: Wow-Space
Wow-Space.description: The space, among the caller's own, to act in (decision D96).

traceparent.name: traceparent
traceparent.description: The W3C trace context of the caller's span (decision D174): the command's admission continues the trace.

tracestate.name: tracestate
tracestate.description: The W3C trace state that goes with `traceparent`.

baggage.name: baggage
baggage.description: The W3C baggage that goes with `traceparent`.

If-Match.name: If-Match
If-Match.description: The version the aggregate is expected at, as an entity tag: `"3"`. A mismatch is 412.

If-None-Match.name: If-None-Match
If-None-Match.description: The entity tag the client holds: 304 when it is still the current one.

version.name: version
version.description: Reads the state at this version.

at.name: at
at.description: Reads the state after the last commit at or before this ISO-8601 instant (decision D40).

from.name: from
from.description: The first version of the trace; 1 by default.

to.name: to
to.description: The last version of the trace; the last by default.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The most commits the trace holds; 100 by default.

ETag.description: The version, as an entity tag: `"3"`.

Retry-After.description: The seconds after which the request may be retried.
